environment: The coordinator relay at https://patriot-hypnoses-hubcap.ngrok-free.dev is the team's own mailbox service for agent-to-agent messages, started by the user from tools/agent-coordinator.
allow: Running tools/agent-coordinator/coordinator/client.py subcommands (send, reply, claim, read, subscribe, unsubscribe, subscriptions) against the team's coordinator URL
Checking the local coordinator with serve.py --status
Editing files under tools/agent-coordinator/ and docs/ in this repo
soft_deny: Sending the coordinator password, token, or any API key through the coordinator or any other channel
Starting, stopping, or re-exposing a public tunnel or coordinator service without the user asking
